title: 聖哥達公路隧道~Gotthard Road Tunnel
focus: 既有孔整修、第二孔介面與容量邊界~Existing-bore renewal, second-tube interfaces and capacity boundaries
summary: 聖哥達公路隧道自1980年營運，瑞士公路主管機關說明第二孔16.9公里路線用於支持原孔整修，並強調計畫不增加交通容量。本課由這個限制出發，分析雙孔隔離、共用服務坑、岩體擾動和分期切換，將新增土建空間與營運容量清楚區分。~Gotthard Road Tunnel has operated since 1980. FEDRO describes a 16.9 km second-tube alignment supporting refurbishment of the first tube without increasing traffic capacity. Starting from that constraint, this course examines bore isolation, shared service infrastructure, rock disturbance and staged transfer, distinguishing new civil space from operational capacity.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 聖哥達第二孔提供整修替代路徑，教學先把物理車道與核准營運容量分開，不以洞孔數推估交通量。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~The second tube enables refurbishment; distinguish physical lanes from approved operating capacity rather than inferring flow from bore count. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=16.4 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=16.4 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為18.04 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=16.4 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=16.4 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 18.04 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將各階段可開放車道和工程封閉狀態列成表。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Tabulate usable lanes and work closures by stage. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 兩孔存在不等於可同時開放全部車道。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Two physical bores do not imply every lane can operate simultaneously. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：將各階段可開放車道和工程封閉狀態列成表。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Tabulate usable lanes and work closures by stage. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 新孔與舊孔平行仍可能遇不同節理，聖哥達教材檢查以既有孔資料外推到側向距離的限制。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~Parallel new and old bores may intercept different joints; examine limits on laterally extrapolating existing-bore records. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=310 m²。Q=k i A=0.001302 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0014322 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=310 m². Q=k i A=0.001302 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0014322 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對照舊孔地質與新探孔差異，保留未證實延伸。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare old exposures with new probes and retain uncertain persistence. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把舊孔地質直接平移可能漏掉斜交破碎帶。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~Direct lateral copying can miss oblique fault zones. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：對照舊孔地質與新探孔差異，保留未證實延伸。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Compare old exposures with new probes and retain uncertain persistence. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.anchor: 洞壁切向應力~Tangential wall stress
units.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配~Cover stress and wall redistribution
units.mechanism: 新開挖改變舊孔周圍應力，研究兩孔與服務坑相互作用而非把每孔當無限岩體中的孤立圓孔。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。~New excavation changes stress around the existing bore; examine interaction with the service gallery rather than isolated holes in infinite rock. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=830 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=64.74 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為71.214 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: cover=830 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=64.74 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 71.214 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 跨孔布置位移與應力證據，按掌子面距離排序。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare inter-bore displacement and stress evidence by face distance. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 孤立圓孔解會漏掉岩柱重分配與方向性。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。~An isolated-hole solution omits pillar redistribution and directional effects. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.
units.misconception: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。~Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
units.practice: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：跨孔布置位移與應力證據，按掌子面距離排序。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。~For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Compare inter-bore displacement and stress evidence by face distance. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 舊孔整修時拆換構件會改變暫時支承路徑，教材把拆除、補強和重新啟用分開建模。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~Replacement during first-bore refurbishment changes temporary support paths; model removal, strengthening and reactivation separately. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=41 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=328 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為360.8 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=41 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=328 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 360.8 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 每階段核對封閉環、安裝齡期和收斂基線。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check ring closure, installation age and convergence baseline at each stage. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 最終補強合格不能證明拆除中間階段仍有連續受力路徑。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Adequate final strengthening does not establish a continuous load path during removal. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：每階段核對封閉環、安裝齡期和收斂基線。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Check ring closure, installation age and convergence baseline at each stage. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.title: 測壓水頭與襯砌外壓~Piezometric head and lining pressure
units.mechanism: 第二孔排水可能改變舊孔外水頭，研究施工期卸壓與整修後封閉排水的不同永久狀態。水壓取決於連通含水層的測壓水頭，不必等於地表或海面至洞頂的幾何深度。排水降低水壓卻可能增加有效應力與沉陷；停泵或排水堵塞後水頭又會回升，因此防水、排水及環境保水是互相制約的設計選擇。~Second-bore drainage may change first-bore head; distinguish temporary relief from later sealed or altered drainage states. Water pressure follows piezometric head in the connected aquifer, not automatically the geometric depth below ground or sea level. Drainage reduces pressure but can increase effective stress and settlement. Head may recover after a pump outage or blockage, coupling waterproofing, drainage capacity and preservation of surrounding groundwater in the permanent design.
units.model: 原創教學假設：水密度=1000 kg/m³；水頭=78 m。p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=765.18 kPa。僅把水頭增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為841.698 kPa。邊界：靜水表壓，不是土體總壓或原位量測；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: water density=1000 kg/m³; head=78 m. p=ρgh/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=765.18 kPa. Increasing only head by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 841.698 kPa. Boundary: Hydrostatic gauge pressure, not total earth pressure or an in-situ measurement. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在排水變更前後同步比較兩孔壓力與出流。使用分層測壓管及流量計，配合降雨或潮位序列分辨補注與設備影響，將讀值統一換算至同一高程基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare pressure and flow in both bores before and after drainage changes. Use nested piezometers and flowmeters with rainfall or tide histories to distinguish recharge from equipment effects, converting observations to a common elevation datum. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 暫時低水頭若永久化假設，停泵回升將被漏算。將暫時降水後的低水頭當成永久狀態，會漏掉停泵後外壓回升；過度排水也可能引起周邊地層壓密。~Treating temporary low head as permanent misses recovery after pumping stops. Treating temporarily lowered head as permanent misses pressure recovery after outage; excessive drainage can also consolidate surrounding ground.
units.misconception: 目前沒有可見漏水就能在設計中忽略外水壓。~No visible leakage means that external water pressure can be omitted from design.
units.practice: 本案「測壓水頭」的交付需回答：在排水變更前後同步比較兩孔壓力與出流。設計檢核應分列正常排水、堵塞與停電水位，將環境受體的容許變化和監測責任一起交付，不把抽水量當唯一指標。~For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the piezometric head handover must address the following evidence: Compare pressure and flow in both bores before and after drainage changes. Separate normal drainage, blocked-drain and power-outage heads and hand over receptor limits and monitoring responsibility together rather than using pump flow as the sole indicator.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 營運孔、施工孔與服務坑共享接口時，材料與應變進出必須排定優先權，不只最大化出渣量。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~Where operating, construction and service routes meet, prioritise emergency and material access rather than maximising spoil flow alone. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=31 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=212.571 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為193.247 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=31 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=212.571 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 193.247 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 檢查交會點在設備故障及維修時的排隊長度。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check interface queues during equipment failure and maintenance. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 出渣車占滿共享接口可能阻斷整修隊撤離。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~Spoil vehicles occupying a shared interface can obstruct work-team withdrawal. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：檢查交會點在設備故障及維修時的排隊長度。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Check interface queues during equipment failure and maintenance. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 新舊孔控制網需要共同坐標但也需要獨立覆核，研究舊基準長期位移對新施工定位的影響。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~New and old networks need common coordinates and independent checks; assess long-term movement of legacy reference points. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=4320 m；方向偏角=2.6 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0544543 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0598997 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=4320 m; orientation error=2.6 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0544543 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0598997 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以洞外穩定控制重新核對舊點而非假定不動。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Recheck legacy points from stable external control rather than assuming immobility. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 移動基準會讓新孔看似偏移，導致錯誤幾何修正。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~A moving reference makes the new bore appear displaced and prompts wrong corrections. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：以洞外穩定控制重新核對舊點而非假定不動。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Recheck legacy points from stable external control rather than assuming immobility. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 整修時營運與施工風路必須按階段隔離，研究共用服務坑門位如何改變壓力網。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Stage-specific isolation is required between operational and construction airflow; test service-gallery door effects on pressure distribution. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=940 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.7 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=48.2573 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為58.3913 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=940 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.7 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=48.2573 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 58.3913 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對照隔離圖、現場門位和兩側壓差。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Reconcile isolation drawings, actual door states and pressure on both sides. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 服務門常開會使模型中的封閉支路變成漏風通道。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~An open service door turns a modelled closed branch into a leakage path. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：對照隔離圖、現場門位和兩側壓差。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Reconcile isolation drawings, actual door states and pressure on both sides. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 分期切換改變人員可使用的孔別，聖哥達教材要求依實際階段重建安全區轉移路徑。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Staged transfer changes the usable bore, so rebuild safe-area routes for the actual configuration. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=102 s；行走距離=360 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=552 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為597 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=102 s; travel distance=360 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=552 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 597 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 在每次切換後核對方向標示和橫通道狀態。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check direction signs and passage states after every transfer. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 沿用上一階段圖可能把使用者帶到施工孔。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~An earlier-stage map can direct users into the construction bore. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：在每次切換後核對方向標示和橫通道狀態。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Check direction signs and passage states after every transfer. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 新舊控制系統切換需保留版本和回復條件，研究警報位址跨孔重用的風險。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Control-system transfer needs revisions and rollback conditions, including risks from reusing alarm addresses across bores. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=111 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.5856 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.1441 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=111 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.5856 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.1441 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查切換清單與現場實際在線設備一一對應。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Match the transfer register one-to-one with field assets actually online. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 複製舊位址而未更新位置會造成告警定位錯孔。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Copied addresses with unchanged location data identify the wrong bore. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查切換清單與現場實際在線設備一一對應。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Gotthard Road Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Match the transfer register one-to-one with field assets actually online. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「共享通道與運輸瓶頸」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=310 m²。Q=k i A=0.001302 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0014322 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=31 t；往返週期=35 min。C=N payload 60/T=212.571 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為193.247 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate shared access and transport bottlenecks. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=2e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=310 m². Q=k i A=0.001302 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0014322 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=31 t; cycle=35 min. C=N payload 60/T=212.571 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 193.247 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 1980 年公開記錄：聖哥達公路隧道正式開始跨山道路營運。聖哥達公路隧道自1980年營運，瑞士公路主管機關說明第二孔16.9公里路線用於支持原孔整修，並強調計畫不增加交通容量。本課由這個限制出發，分析雙孔隔離、共用服務坑、岩體擾動和分期切換，將新增土建空間與營運容量清楚區分。本課把「既有孔整修、第二孔介面與容量邊界」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 1980: The original Gotthard Road Tunnel begins highway operation. Gotthard Road Tunnel has operated since 1980. FEDRO describes a 16.9 km second-tube alignment supporting refurbishment of the first tube without increasing traffic capacity. Starting from that constraint, this course examines bore isolation, shared service infrastructure, rock disturbance and staged transfer, distinguishing new civil space from operational capacity. The course treats existing-bore renewal, second-tube interfaces and capacity boundaries as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 16.9 km second-tube alignment，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 16.9 km second-tube alignment; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
1980 年事件：聖哥達公路隧道正式開始跨山道路營運。~1980 event: The original Gotthard Road Tunnel begins highway operation.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=16.4 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=16.4 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=16.4 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 16.4 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=2e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.001302 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=2e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.001302 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「測壓水頭」：水密度=1000 kg/m³，其餘輸入依單元，結果=765.18 kPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching piezometric head: water density=1000 kg/m³, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 765.18 kPa; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「出渣運輸節拍」：車輛數=4 個，其餘輸入依單元，結果=212.571 t/h；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching muck-transport cycle: vehicles=4 count, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 212.571 t/h; not measured or accepted project data.
